items.content:
The MakerSpace is good. I want to be clear with myself about that,
because the thing I'm about to think sits next to something ugly.

It got funded. The printers, the vinyl cutter, the staff hours. Meanwhile
the materials budget halved. Nobody stood up and decided to defund the
humanities — but money moves toward whatever can be photographed for a
press release, and a kid reading in a chair cannot be photographed.

summary: The MakerSpace deserved funding, but money follows what photographs well
title: On the MakerSpace, fairly
